main_text.p: Quarto de reliquis quinq; domicilijs orienta-libus, quæ decimæ continuo ordine succedunt ad imum cœli usq; & hemisphærium orientale occu-pant & complent, de singulis illis (inquam) ordi-dine 30 tempora æquatoris ascensioni medij cœli adiungimus, qua additione singularum conficimus ascensiones obliquas.

Quinto, loca Ecliptica his congruentia ex cer-tis latitudinum tabulis, quæ singulis seruiunt ex-cerpimus. Cuspidi primæ domus inueniendi seruit canon ascensionum conditus ad latitudinem loci propositi. At latitudo loci uicissim in tabula, ut uo-catur rationali, Canones reliquis domicilijs ac-commodatas demonstrat. In area enim tabulæ ra-tionalis duo perpetuo numeri distincti occurrunt, Q 5 anno-

page.notes: The table figures are partly unclear in the scan (the degree signs and the 17 column); the "Q 5" and "anno" at the end are a catchword-like fragment of the line and are kept as printed. Figures in the table lines are set in a column and may be misaligned in the transcription.
